description: Primary-source number theory, RH/GRH formalization, and computational algorithm papers mounted for Phase 2 audit of rh_2026_implications_7a.

documents.title: Remark on the Formalized Proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
documents.summary: Primary 4-page announcement & proof-timeline overview: Stepanov determinant & multiplicity via sqrt(X)-length iterated theta lifts U(X_0)->...->U(X_m) between totally definite unitary groups, Chowla-Selberg/Weyl/Siegel mass divisibility, Bessel/GGP periods & Rallis seesaw, sixfold cover of GL_5, Bost slope inequality, weakening of Vandiver, Guinand-Weil test functions, and explicit note that ERH is not yet formalized.

documents.title: The Riemann Hypothesis: Past, Present and a Letter Through Time
documents.summary: Survey and original 'Letter to Riemann' proving that extremizing restrictions of Weil's quadratic form on finite prime truncations (e.g., primes < 13) produces approximations lying strictly on Re(z) = 1/2 (accuracies down to 2.6e-55 for first 50 zeros), connected to information theory and trace formulas.

documents.title: Conditional bounds for the least quadratic non-residue and related problems
documents.authors: Youness Lamzouri, Xiannan Li, Kannan Soundararajan
documents.summary: Derives fully explicit, computable bounds under GRH: sharpens Ankeny/Bach bounds for the least quadratic non-residue (e.g., n_p < (ln p)^2), least prime in arithmetic progressions, and explicit computable Littlewood bounds on L(1, chi).

documents.title: Beyond the Riemann Hypothesis bounds: A pair-correlation approach to the least prime in arithmetic progression and the smallest quadratic non-residue
documents.authors: Neelam Kandhil, Alessandro Languasco, Pieter Moree
documents.summary: Shows how vertical spacing / pair-correlation of Dirichlet L-function zeros sharpens bounds beyond classical horizontal GRH bounds for both the smallest prime in an arithmetic progression and the least quadratic non-residue.

documents.title: Landau-Siegel zeros over a base field and effective Brauer-Siegel
documents.summary: Proves effective lower bounds (1 - beta) log d_F >= c(k) for real zeros of L(s, chi_{F/k}) and deduces an effective, uniform Brauer-Siegel theorem h_K R_K >= c(k) d_K^{1/2} / ((2 pi)^{[K:Q]} log d_K) via uniform Chebotarev sums.

documents.title: Breaking the 4 barrier for the bound of a generating set of the class group
documents.summary: Under GRH, provides a new algorithm computing a generating set of the ideal class group of K with ideal norms <= (4 - 1/(2n)) log^2 Delta (or (4 - 2/(3n)) log^2 Delta for odd class number), improving Buchmann's class group algorithm below the 4 log^2 Delta barrier.
